text: A.J. Brown's return from injured reserve has hit a speed bump this week as the receiver missed Thursday's practice due to a new knee ailment layered on top of his previously injured ankle, leaving his status uncertain heading into Sunday's AFC East matchup against the Dolphins. The Patriots' secondary, meanwhile, is expected to be fully healthy for the road trip to Miami, a bright spot as the team looks to secure their third divisional win of the season after working through a mini bye week. The Dolphins, who will have most of their current roster facing the Patriots for the first time, are hoping to build momentum against the defending AFC East champion, though the Patriots' seven-game body of work and survivor pool analysts suggest New England remains the road favorite in this Week 8 divisional battle at Hard Rock Stadium on Sunday at 4:15 PM ET.
